goals: Provide fail-closed Xaero entity-head icons for Ribbits through a distinct compatibility companion without changing normal Ribbits rendering or the EMF companion behavior.

Maintain an explicitly registered ordinary Ribbit and Wandering Ribbit GeckoLib capture provider; ordinary main/body remains DIRECT-CUBES-ONLY, while Wandering selects only its face core and paired eyes.

Preserve required Ribbits/GeckoLib API and per-capture contracts without release fingerprint gates; preserve Xaero binary seams, bounded caches, render-state/reload/transform and private-asset boundaries while awaiting visual runtime evidence.
scope: Wrap the sole RadarIconForm.getPrerenderer call in Xaero RadarIconCreator.create for only exact unsupported ribbits:ribbit or ribbits:wandering_ribbit renderers; preserve vanilla, Ender Dragon, EMF, already-handled, disabled-head and category-filtered paths.

Reuse Xaero populated render state and active model/texture. Ordinary Ribbits retain required profession/Pride/instrument/umbrella/rain tickets; exact WanderingRibbitRenderer/WanderingRibbitModel require living Geo state and no custom Ribbit tickets.

Ordinary selection preserves every direct cube at exact main/body, inherited bind and cube transforms, and excludes every descendant/sibling. Wandering uses the same exact hierarchy but a separate fail-closed geometry selector for its face core and two eyes; excludes direct clothing/backpack and descendant/sibling accessories/limbs.

Normalize selected transformed bounds to the ordinary Xaero head capture span of 16 pixels (32 pixels per model unit times 8/16 head units), preserving capture min(1, Parameters.scale) and downstream display scale. Map Gecko baked +Y/-Z to screen -Y/camera +Z without the erroneous Y half-turn; inherited creator capture pose is identity.

Keep bounded model/texture/profession/Pride/baby/reload identities; ordinary and Wandering have distinct entity/provider/selector identities, including unresolved sentinels. Invalidate both successful and FAILED outer entity caches on reload, without enabling arbitrary GeckoLib entities.

Canary 5 validates actual Ribbits C10 and C9 across GeckoLib 5.5.4 and 5.5.1 with unchanged EMF C4 and exact Xaero 26.4.2/nested XaeroLib 1.7.1. Ribbits and GeckoLib eligibility uses mod presence and required APIs, never version, whole-archive size/hash or archive layout. Preserve per-capture entity/renderer/state/resource/geometry checks; do not reintroduce a Canary pin for a compatible update.

exclusions: Any EMF companion implementation, artifact, status or behavior changes.
Changes to projects/ribbits-26.2, its renderer, private resources, artifacts, releases, lifecycle, or runtime evidence.
A dummy vanilla EntityModel or ModelPart facade, whole-body Gecko capture, mutation or replay of the in-world renderer, recursive body rendering, or a generic head-bone heuristic.
Ordinary Ribbit cube pruning; automatic support for arbitrary GeckoLib entities; animation time, transient progress, entity UUID or world position in cache keys.
Redistribution of Xaero All Rights Reserved code/assets, private or donor-derived Ribbits models/textures/manifests, decompiled upstream class bodies, or unlicensed static icon art.
Deployment, Minecraft launch, Test Slot A or B use, accepted-baseline mutation, or any claim of runtime validation for this static candidate.
Modification of the dedicated Workbench profile, runtime-manager state, originals, or any access to the protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay instance.

state.milestone: Canary 5 removes the Ribbits C9 version/size/SHA-256/origin gate so compatible releases, including C10, remain eligible. Required directly linked Ribbits APIs are checked by bytecode signatures without early game classloading; per-capture contracts and all C4 face/size/Wandering/cache behavior remain unchanged. Actual C9/C10 crossed with GeckoLib 5.5.4/5.5.1 pass 78 tests in 17 suites and the production Knot/Mixin harness. Retained successor is 64,544 bytes, runtime untested and unaccepted. User reports icons worked with Ribbits C9 but stopped with C10; this matches the removed gate, but installed companion binary/session identity is unspecified, so no exact-release visual PASS/FAIL is assigned. Prior visual failure identity limits remain in the log. No runtime or instance transition.
